text:
Anita Shah: Thanks for the all-hands — dropping this thread for follow-ups on reviews/promos/comp/benefits. Ask away and we'll triage.

Carlos Mejia: Quick: will stock refreshers be considered as part of comp discussions or handled separately?

Anita Shah: Stock refreshers are handled outside the promo comp adjustments but managers can note expected grants in the packet. The formal grant decision is separate and follows compensation approval.

Riley Park: Are there any changes to parental leave/top-up or other benefits tied to promotion timing?

Anita Shah: No policy changes this cycle. Parental leave/top-ups unaffected by promotion date. If someone's on leave during calibration, coordinators will work with the manager to ensure fair review.

Nora Patel: For leveling, is there an updated rubric for L4->L5 engineering? I want clear examples to cite.

Anita Shah: Updated rubrics are in the leveling repo: https://redwood.internal/people/leveling-rubrics (L4->L5 section has new examples). Ping me if something is unclear.

Devon Brooks: If a manager provides weak impact bullets, can People Ops help rewrite before calibration?

Anita Shah: Yes — People Ops will help polish packets for clarity, not to change substance. Submit requests by Mon 5/4 so we can queue them.

Carlos Mejia: Do we have anonymized internal comp comparisons managers can reference?

Anita Shah: Yes — managers can request an anonymized comp snapshot from People Ops during calibration. It includes percentiles by role and region.

Riley Park: What if someone feels their role scope changed drastically mid-cycle but manager didn't update the packet? Best path?

Anita Shah: Ask the manager to update now. If manager and IC disagree, escalate to skip-level + People Ops. We'll review scope changes and may treat as exception.

peopleops-bot: :calendar: Heads-up: Calibration window opens 2026-04-25 and closes 2026-04-30. Reminder emails scheduled.

Nora Patel: Appeals window? Can ICs submit new evidence after decisions?

Anita Shah: Appeals open for 10 business days post-communication. New evidence allowed but should be time-bound (e.g., recent missed project callouts). Appeals aren't guaranteed adjustments; they trigger a formal re-review.

Devon Brooks: Is there guidance on writing impact statements for ICs who do cross-functional ops work?

Anita Shah: Yes — use the cross-functional impact template in the promo packet. Focus on outcomes, metrics, and stakeholder testimonials. Example bullets in the template.

Carlos Mejia: If a manager misses the calibration deadline, will that person be auto-defaulted to no change?

Anita Shah: We try to avoid defaults. Late packets create delays; People Ops will work with the manager and Director. In extreme cases, decisions may be postponed until packet is received.

Riley Park: How granular is the market data (location, experience)?

Anita Shah: Market data is segmented by role family, level, and major region (US, EMEA, APAC). For edge cases we can pull vendor data for specific local markets.

Nora Patel: Can managers request a one-off comp adjustment outside promo window for retention?

Anita Shah: Yes, but those are exceptional. Managers submit a retention comp request with business justification; People Ops + Finance review. Expect a 2-3 week turnaround.

Devon Brooks: Any change to the bonus calculation? Heard a rumor about weighting.

Anita Shah: No change to bonus calculation this year. If that changes we'll announce with enough lead time.

Carlos Mejia: Confidentiality: who exactly gets access to nomination packets?

Anita Shah: Access limited to manager, skip-level, calibration panel members, People Ops, and Finance approvers where needed. Packets are stored in a restricted drive.

peopleops-bot: :memo: Promo packet template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/people/promo-packet-v2.md

Anita Shah: I'll compile a short FAQ/one-pager for ICs and share by EOD Friday. Tagging folks who've asked here for any follow-ups. Thanks all. :sparkles:
